hiscore.mode_comment: auto = use the Hardcore Worlds table once the watcher finds it. Or set a mode name, e.g. hiscore_oldschool_hardcore_ironman for testing.
hiscore.relay_comment: Used only when a ranking page answers 403 (GitHub's servers). Needs the LEDGER_RELAY_KEY secret, shared with the Worker's LEDGER_KEY.

tracking.comment: Players polled one by one (scraper/tracking.py). api = the Cloudflare Worker that stores names visitors track on the site (worker/). null = top-50 seeds only.

listing.comment: Who gets a gravestone. min_total rises with the size of the hiscores; the scan stops at the page where total level falls below it.

x.comment: Automatic posts to X (scraper/xposts.py). dry_run true = write would-be posts to xposts.json on the state branch, send nothing. Live also needs the secrets X_API_KEY, X_API_SECRET, X_ACCESS_TOKEN, X_ACCESS_SECRET. launch_at drives the first-hour post. Other knobs and their defaults are in DEFAULTS at the top of xposts.py.
x.scheduled_comment: Countdown/hype posts. Each needs approved: true to go out. 'at' is UTC; a post more than 3h late is skipped. on: worlds_listed fires once when Hardcore Worlds appear in the world list (not before 'at').

scheduled.text:
2 days.

On 4 November, Old School RuneScape opens Hardcore Worlds. Everyone starts together. Everyone gets one life.

Death has already cleared his schedule.

Tomorrow, Hardcore Worlds open.

Plan your route. Know what you keep on death. Don't trust the Wilderness, a dark cave or a full inventory of food you'll never eat in time.

One life. Death is patient.

Last night before Hardcore Worlds.

Tomorrow thousands of fresh characters log in with one life each. By tomorrow night, some of them will be names on a gravestone.

Sleep well.

Today.

Hardcore Worlds open on Old School RuneScape. Fresh start, one life, no safety net.

The ledger is open. The first grave is coming.

The worlds are open.

One life. Death is patient.

He won't have to be for long.
